scope: Independent reproduction extraction startup waits only
cause: The first independent bootstrap timed out at its 45 second asynchronous lifecycle response limit. The observed navigation startup interval was 120.25 wall seconds, so the old waiter rejected a still-starting lifecycle manager.
readiness_derivation: 60 discovery + 10 warmup + 2*150 lifecycle manager response + 9*5 state response = 415 wall seconds; 65 seconds explicit margin gives 480
unchanged: 900 wall second simulator first-frame startup limit
60 actual model requests, 2400 simulation seconds, 3600 wall seconds per Agent batch
navigation qualification limits and stopping conditions
physical arrival, fresh telemetry, real stationary confirmation and motion guard
Nav2 parameters, station coordinates, map and delivery business validation
fresh_installation: Run prepare on untouched source using the updated apply_portability.py and baseline-sha256.json; the resulting manifest explicitly records this revision and both limits.
existing_prepared_copy: Run python3 portable/migrate_startup_patch.py --root /your/short/repro-validation/project. It accepts only a validated inactive copy or an empty live run with watch off, no navigation, fresh physical stop and guard disarmed. It checks the exact project container label and /project mount when live. All original bound source hashes and config digest must match before source writes.
migration_preservation: Original source-patch-manifest.json, portability.patch and both source files are backed up in a new runs/reproduction/startup-wait-migration-* directory before commit. Original failed bootstrap logs are never edited. Only the two unique waits are migrated and recorded in the source manifest and diff.
runtime_actions: None. Migration does not start, stop, cancel, resume or restart any process, container, robot or model session.
acceptance_status: Offline static generation and refusal checks only. Actual cold-start, navigation and physical stop must be reverified in separate real runtime evidence; a previous failed bootstrap remains failed.
